wanted: Heading with a visual size separate from its level: quote shows the headline small (type-h3 look) at h2/h1 level, so it uses a plain h1/h2 element with the type-h3 class instead of the kit's Heading

A kit way to render one rich-text paragraph's spans (marks and links) at another text style: quote re-implements the span rendering to set the opening paragraph large, and wraps the body in a display:contents element so one data-slot="body" covers both parts
A way to keep list items whole across newspaper columns (break-inside: avoid on li): in columns, a bullet can split between the two columns
The sheet only renders typical content, so the two-column mode of columns (body of 600+ characters) and long bodies were reviewed with a hand-made page outside the repository
notes: Both test commands passed first time; preview round 1 found the phone layout of overlap indented the whole text column, so on phones the panel now cuts into the start corner and keeps the page edge. overlap caps body at 900 characters because longer text turns the panel into a tall narrow column far below the photo; quote dropped the suggested small photo so its signature can honestly say no image.
